description: A model with an entity named toString, a property of Object.prototype: the reference checker refuses the model, and so does the CLI, saying why.
stricter: The reference checker (core since #5, commit dd5ce32) keeps the names of a model in objects without a prototype, so a name of Object.prototype is an ordinary name and the model is accepted, as ModelSpec's own lint accepts it. The CLI still refuses a model that declares one (as the reference checker did until then), so that reading meaning/draft-1 does not change in the release that reads meaning/draft-2; accepting these names is a separate change (cli#10).
